objectives.title: Operate an autonomous evidence-driven portfolio intelligence system
objectives.statement: Build a self-triggering portfolio intelligence layer that continuously observes, learns, hunts, experiments, verifies, and improves without requiring interactive ChatGPT for ordinary operation while keeping consequential external authority human-gated.
success_conditions: Ordinary portfolio learning cycles can execute from durable automation without an interactive ChatGPT prompt.
Verified outcomes update durable shared state and future decision policy.
constraints: No autonomous live trading or brokerage execution.
No secrets or private operational/customer payloads stored while this repository is public.
evidence_requirements: Exact source revisions and durable event/evidence receipts.
Deterministic tests plus independent verification for consequential promotion.

objectives.title: Produce verified cash from existing capabilities before new product expansion
objectives.statement: Prioritize paid implementation work in categories buyers already purchase, starting with rescue and stabilization of AI-built applications and GitHub delivery systems. Freeze net-new startup architecture until verified external payment or explicit buyer evidence justifies expansion.
success_conditions: At least one verified external payment is collected for a bounded service delivered primarily from existing portfolio capabilities.
Every active revenue experiment has a named buyer problem, bounded scope, explicit price, current demand evidence, and a kill rule.
Net-new startup architecture remains frozen until the first verified payment or a human explicitly overrides this objective.
constraints: Do not fabricate demand, revenue, customer interest, delivery success, or payment.
Do not make purchases, send unapproved external communications, or create customer commitments outside existing human authority gates.
Existing high-friction product concepts may be maintained for correctness but do not receive expansion work without external evidence.
Prefer read-only or least-privilege access and keep customer secrets and private payloads out of the public repository.
evidence_requirements: Provider-backed payment or settlement evidence tied to the specific engagement.
Delivery and customer-acceptance evidence tied to the agreed scope.
Current market-demand evidence or an inbound buyer request for the service category.

provenance.source_ref: Owner revenue reset instruction in ChatGPT on 2026-09-27
